confirm.title: Delete fund {symbol}?
confirm.description:
The Zwitserleven fund overview page no longer lists fund {symbol}, so its price sensor is unavailable.

If Zwitserleven has closed or renamed the fund, select **Submit** to delete the fund with its device, sensor and stored prices. If you expect the fund to come back, close this dialog instead: the issue goes away by itself when the fund is listed again.
